offers.description: Available as an individual service pick ($250 USD for individuals / $250 USD for businesses, each for 5 days of live training + 5 days of dedicated support, 10 days total coverage), or as part of our comprehensive programs: Business Training ($2,500 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, 30 working days over 8 weeks with 8 - 10 days as holidays and recovery days, 4 hours per day, up to 10 participants, +$250/extra seat) or Personal Training ($2,500 USD for 60 days: 30d training + 30d guidance/materials, 30 working days over 6 weeks with 8 - 10 days as holidays and recovery days, 4 hours per day, 1 person only). Clients are free to pick and choose their services. Full 195-country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) supported across all service pricing.

serviceOutput: Self-Hosted Local n8n Setup: Docker Compose orchestration with PostgreSQL, local Ollama LLM bridge, and LangChain AI Agent nodes.
Make Scenario Architecture: High-throughput visual scenarios with multi-branch routers, iterator/aggregator modules, and robust error handlers.
IFTTT Event Bridges: Streamlined webhooks and multi-applet mobile alerts for lightweight cross-platform triggers.
Open-Source Automation: Deploying Activepieces, Windmill, and Node-RED for cost-free, self-hosted operational workflows.
50% Daily Workflow Automation: Connecting webhooks, databases, CRMs, Slack, and email into resilient, automated business pipelines.
